text:
tom: Kicking off blue/green rollout for router v3.2.1 -> v3.3.0 now. Change window 2026-03-21 20:00-21:00 UTC. Canary 5% for 10m. Posting release notes and runbook.

deploy-bot: rollout job roll-6732 started. Canary stage: 5% traffic to green. Job link: https://deploy/release/roll-6732

maya: I’ll watch p95, 5xx, and tail latency. Abort criteria: p95 +200ms vs baseline OR 5xx >0.5% sustained for 3m.

sasha: Ran smoke tests against green in staging. Session affinity passes, cookie TTL unchanged. No obvious serialization errors.

alex: FYI eu-west has an older sidecar (v1.4) — could cause TLS mismatch for green. Recommend excluding eu-west until sidecar patched.

tom: OK we’ll pin eu-west to blue for this rollout. global canary remains 5% excluding eu-west.

deploy-bot: Routing policy updated: eu-west pinned -> blue. Canary adjusted to 5% global excluding regions: [eu-west].

oncall-bot: New alert rule added: router.v3.3.0.error_rate > 0.5% for 3m -> notify #eng-oncall and page oncall@pagerduty.

sasha: Canary 5% metrics after 10m: errors 0.04%, p95 -8ms, success rate steady. No memory spikes.

maya: Starting ramp to 50% over 15m. I’ll run the LB weight update script now.

maya: ```
# update weights
curl -X POST https://router-api.internal/weights \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"target":"green","weight":50,"deployed_by":"maya"}'
```

deploy-bot: Weight update applied. Current distribution: green 50%, blue 50% (eu-west pinned to blue).

alex: Observability note — tracing shows new allocator in v3.3.0 has slightly higher tail CPU for attach requests; tracking.

maya: 50% stable for 12m. No increase in errors. Proceeding to 95% over next 10m, leave eu-west pinned.

tom: Before 95% ramp, add version pin fallback: if errors spike, immediately pin traffic back to blue via route-pin command. Release notes updated with rollback steps.

sasha: Copy. Rollback command:

`deploy-bot: /route-pin --to blue --reason "auto-rollback" --release roll-6732`

maya: 95% ramp complete. Metrics look fine. Finalizing release: promote green to primary in metadata and update release notes with changelog entries.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete. v3.3.0 promoted. roll-6732 -> SUCCESS. Release note: "router: fix kv cache reseed, perf improvements for short seqs".

tom: Great job team. Follow-up items: eu-west sidecar upgrade (alex), postmortem if any lingering tail CPU (sasha). I'll file PR for docs + runbook.

sasha: minor FYI — we saw an anomalous 429 burst from a downstream client during 50% ramp, but it was client-side retry loop; coordinated with infra to throttle. Not an internal fault.

maya: Marking this thread closed. :tada:
